messages.subject: adding column name while casting
parts:
Hi,
Is there a way to specify the column name of the "(all)" column while
casting?

> mydf <- cast(airquality, Month ~ ., mean)
Month (all)
1 5 16.0
2 6 15.5
3 7 16.0
4 8 16.0
5 9 15.5

So I don't have to do this second step: colnames(mydf)[2] <- "average"

Thanks,

Nacho

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: adding column name while casting
parts:
Hi Nacho,

No, not currently. You can also use the rename function.

Hadley
